name: Brantford Public Library
indoor_location: Ground floor: turn left past the main circulation desk, hallway on the left side. Second washroom on 2nd floor: take elevator or stairs, turn right, past the reference section.

name: Harmony Square Public Washrooms
address: Dalhousie St & Colborne St, Brantford, ON N3T 2J1
indoor_location: Outdoor/semi-covered washroom kiosk at the northeast corner of Harmony Square. No building entry required — look for the small brick structure facing Dalhousie St.

name: Wayne Gretzky Sports Centre
address: 254 North Park St, Brantford, ON N3R 4L1
indoor_location: Main arena level: washrooms located on both sides of the main lobby just past the front desk, adjacent to the skate rental counter. Additional washrooms in the aquatic centre corridor, follow signs from the pool entrance.

name: Brantford Civic Centre / City Hall
indoor_location: Ground floor: washrooms located in the main lobby corridor, past the security desk on the right side. Upper floors have restricted access — ground floor only for public use.

name: Brantford General Hospital (Public Entrance)
address: 200 Terrace Hill St, Brantford, ON N3R 1G9
indoor_location: Main building: washrooms near the main entrance lobby, to the right of the information desk. Emergency department has a separate public washroom in the waiting area. Follow hospital signage from any entrance.

name: Sanderson Centre for the Performing Arts
indoor_location: Main floor lobby: washrooms on either side of the main entrance foyer before entering the theatre. Accessible washroom on the main floor near the coat check. Upper balcony washrooms available during performances only.
hours_open: Event days only — check schedule; typically 1 hour before showtime

name: Lynwood Mall
indoor_location: Centre court: washrooms located mid-mall on the south side, adjacent to the food court seating area. Follow the mall directory signs — look for the washroom icon near the central atrium. Family washroom available at the same location.

name: Glenhyrst Art Gallery
indoor_location: Ground floor: washrooms located to the left of the main entrance reception desk. Single accessible washroom available. Outdoor gardens do not have facilities — use the gallery washrooms before exploring the grounds.

name: Brantford Downtown Farmers' Market
address: 46 Market St S, Brantford, ON N3T 3A1
indoor_location: Inside the market building: washrooms at the rear of the main market hall, against the back wall on the left side. Access from the main entrance, walk straight through the vendor stalls toward the far end.

name: Brantford Bus Terminal
indoor_location: Inside the main terminal waiting area: washrooms are located at the back left corner of the waiting room, past the ticket counter. Accessible entrance through the main doors on Darling St.

name: Confederation Park
address: Colborne St E & Clarence St, Brantford, ON
indoor_location: Outdoor park washroom building located in the northwest corner of the park, near the parking lot entrance off Colborne St E. Standalone brick structure — look for it near the splash pad area.

name: Brantford YMCA
indoor_location: Main floor lobby: public washrooms available just past the front reception desk on the right. Members-only change rooms are beyond the access gate. The lobby washroom near the entrance is open to visitors.
